item.title: [Featured Article] Talking to Yourself
item.description: "Talking to Yourself" is a song by Carly Rae Jepsen from her sixth studio album, The Loneliest Time (2022). Jepsen wrote it with songwriter Simon Wilcox and its producers, Benjamin Berger and Ryan Rabin from the production team Captain Cuts. School Boy and Interscope Records released it as the album's third single on September 16, 2022. "Talking to Yourself" is a dance-pop and synth-pop song, in which Jepsen recalls a relationship with an ex-lover and wonders if he still has feelings for her.

item.title: [In the News] The space probe Voyager 1 (rendering shown) becomes the first human-made object to reach one light-day from Earth.
item.description: Voyager 1 is a space probe launched by NASA on September 5, 1977, as part of the Voyager program, to study the outer Solar System and the interstellar space beyond the Sun's heliosphere. At a distance of 173.02 AU as of November 2026, it is the most distant human-made object from Earth.

item.title: [In the News] In Canadian football, the Edmonton Elks defeat the Montreal Alouettes to win the Grey Cup.
item.description: The 113th Grey Cup was a Canadian football game played to decide the Canadian Football League (CFL) championship for the 2026 season. The game was played on November 15, 2026, at McMahon Stadium in Calgary, Alberta. It was the sixth time that Calgary hosted the Grey Cup, with the previous being in 2019. The West Division champion Edmonton Elks defeated the East Division champion Montreal Alouettes 37–30. This was their first Grey Cup win since 2015 and first since changing their team name in 2021.

item.title: [In the News] Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amidst allegations of being targeted by a Chinese spy and of having extramarital affairs.
item.description: Jen-Hsun "Jensen" Huang is a Taiwanese and American electrical engineer and businessman. He co-founded the technology company Nvidia, one of the world's most valuable corporations, and served as its president and CEO from its founding in 1993 until his resignation in 2026. As of November 2026, Forbes estimates his net worth at US$128.4 billion, making him the 14th-wealthiest person in the world.

item.title: [In the News] The Salvadoran military intervention in Haiti intensifies with airstrikes on 400 Mawozo's alleged headquarters and a deployment to the Sylvio Cator Stadium.
item.description: Since 21 October 2026, El Salvador has been conducting a military intervention in Haiti following a gang ambush on 18 October that resulted in four Salvadoran aviation technicians of the Gang Suppression Force (GSF) being kidnapped. According to Salvadoran president Nayib Bukele, the intervention's primary objective is to rescue the four technicians, while threatening to "finish" the Haitian gangs if the technicians are not rescued alive.

item.title: [Most Read #1] Grand Theft Auto VI
item.description: Daily Views: 540,793 — Grand Theft Auto VI is a 2026 action-adventure game developed and published by Rockstar Games. It is the eighth main entry in the Grand Theft Auto series, following 2013's Grand Theft Auto V, and the sixteenth entry overall. Set in the fictional US state of Leonida, based on Florida, the story follows the criminal duo of Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos as they lead a life of crime to escape from corrupt police officers. The game's open world allows players to freely roam Leonida and its Miami-inspired Vice City and engage in various side activities.

item.title: [Most Read #2] Ramayana: Part 1
item.description: Daily Views: 329,248 — Ramayana: Part 1 is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language epic mythological film directed by Nitesh Tiwari, who co-wrote the screenplay with Shridhar Raghavan. Produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash, the film is based on the Hindu epic Ramayana by Valmiki. It is the first instalment of a two-part film series, with Part 1 being based on the first three kāṇḍa (chapters) of Ramayana, which chronicle the life of Prince Rama from childhood up to his adventurous 14-year exile. The first part features an ensemble cast that includes Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, Sai Pallavi, Ravi Dubey, Anupam Kher, Kajal Aggarwal, Rakul Preet Singh, Vivek Oberoi, Kunal Kapoor, Adinath Kothare, Arun Govil, Indira Krishnan, and Lara Dutta.

item.title: [Most Read #3] Riemann hypothesis
item.description: Daily Views: 295,157 — In mathematics, the Riemann hypothesis is the statement that the Riemann zeta function has its zeros only at the negative even integers and at complex numbers with real part. Historically, it has had the status of being one of the most important unsolved problems in pure mathematics. It is of great interest in number theory because it implies results about the distribution of prime numbers. It is named after Bernhard Riemann, who proposed it in 1859.

item.title: [Most Read #4] The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
item.description: Daily Views: 174,063 — The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping is a 2026 American dystopian film produced and directed by Francis Lawrence from a screenplay by Billy Ray and Michael Lesslie. Based on the 2025 novel Sunrise on the Reaping by Suzanne Collins, it is the sixth installment in The Hunger Games film series, serving as the second prequel to The Hunger Games (2012) after The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes (2023).

item.title: [Most Read #5] Ken McElroy
item.description: Daily Views: 158,096 — Kenneth Rex McElroy was an American criminal, convicted attempted murderer, child rapist, arsonist, and animal abuser who resided in Skidmore, Missouri. He was known as "the town bully", and his unsolved killing became the focus of international attention. Over the course of his life, McElroy was accused of dozens of felonies, including assault, child molestation, statutory rape, arson, animal cruelty, hog and cattle rustling, and burglary.

item.title: [Most Read #6] Deaths in 2026
item.description: Daily Views: 132,581 — The following notable deaths occurred in 2026. Names are reported under the date of death, in alphabetical order. A typical entry reports information in the following sequence:Name, age, country of citizenship at birth, subsequent nationality, what subject was noted for, cause of death, and a reference.

item.title: [Most Read #7] Grand Theft Auto
item.description: Daily Views: 129,311 — Grand Theft Auto (GTA) is an action-adventure video game series created by the Scottish programmers David Jones and Mike Dailly at DMA Design, now known as Rockstar North. Later titles were developed under the oversight of brothers Dan and Sam Houser, Leslie Benzies and Aaron Garbut. It is primarily developed by Rockstar North and published by its American parent company, Rockstar Games. The name of the series is a term for motor vehicle theft in the United States.

item.title: [Most Read #8] Levent Alpöge
item.description: Daily Views: 124,632 — Levent Hasan Ali Alpöge is a Turkish and American mathematician. He is known for his work in number theory and arithmetic statistics. He was a junior fellow in the Harvard Society of Fellows and later joined the artificial-intelligence company Anthropic as a member of the technical staff. In 2025, he and collaborators gave a second proof that Hilbert's tenth problem has a negative answer over the ring of integers of every algebraic number field, a result originally established by Koymans and Pagano in 2024.

item.title: [Most Read #9] Fiona (hippopotamus)
item.description: Daily Views: 124,449 — Fiona was a female hippopotamus who lived at the Cincinnati Zoo and Botanical Garden in Cincinnati, Ohio, United States. She was the first Nile hippo imaged on ultrasound prenatally, as well the first Nile hippo to be born at the Cincinnati Zoo in over fifty years. She was born six weeks premature and was not expected to survive. After a weeks-long effort by a team of veterinarians and clinicians from the Cincinnati Children's Hospital contributed to her care, Fiona survived. Videos of Fiona became popular on the Internet and her presence increased attendance at the zoo.

item.title: [Most Read #10] Robert Pattinson
item.description: Daily Views: 124,262 — Robert Douglas Thomas Pattinson is an English actor and producer. Pattinson is known for his performances in both major studio productions and independent films, often portraying eccentric characters. His accolades include nominations for an AACTA Award, a Canadian Screen Award and two Independent Spirit Awards. Included on yearly lists of the world's highest-paid actors, he was ranked by Time as one of the 100 most influential people in the world and featured in the Forbes Celebrity 100 in 2010.
